name: The Hollow Crown
notes: Hand-made expedition map (tools/make_hollowcrown.py; the format is described there). A raised core (the Crown, its Throne and two boss Gaols), a ring of four regions each with one plateau reached by stairs, and four quiet outer isles with the exits. Nothing is placed by dice except what the match rolls: which spawn points, lairs and camps are live, loot, the Blight, weather.

regions.name: The Crown
regions.purpose: Contested core: the vault on the Throne, two boss Gaols, the richest loot and the most Blight. Every route in is a bridge or a glide over open air.

regions.name: Frostgate
regions.purpose: Northern ridge and Keep: high ground over the Gate Span, a camp to level on, Rimefield cover.

regions.name: Cinder Steps
regions.purpose: Western forge country: the Kilns overlook the Crown's west face; the Ash Bridge to the Ashen Gaol.

regions.name: Stormbreak
regions.purpose: Eastern tableland with the shrine on the Shrine Table; Storm Halt (sky train) off its east rim.

regions.name: Thornwood
regions.purpose: Southern wood: tall grass ambushes, the Boki nest, the Thornhive lair and its uplink.

regions.name: Larkhollow
regions.purpose: Quiet NW landing with a skiff dock.

regions.name: Highwatch
regions.purpose: Quiet NE landing with an uplink outpost.

regions.name: Duskmoor
regions.purpose: Quiet SE landing with a skiff dock.

regions.name: Saltmere
regions.purpose: Quiet SW landing with an uplink outpost.
